newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Etec Systems started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Etec Systems started.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group Inc said on Tuesday it initiated coverage of Etec Systems Inc with a short-term hold rating and long-term buy rating.
-- SoundView semiconductor capital equipment analyst Michael O'Brien set a fiscal 1997 earnings estimate of $1.67 per share and a fiscal 1998 estimate of $2.59 per share.
-- O'Brien said in a research note he set a 12-month price target of $60 per share.

-- "It's a great growth story long-term but they need to resolve issues with their Polyscan system," he said. "I also think the company is being overly cautious in its guidance, which is creating investor confusion."
